original_text:
PhD Position in Geometric Deep Learning and Graph Signal Processing
We are opening a fully funded PhD position at Télécom Paris and Télécom SudParis, Institut Polytechnique de Paris, within the Hi! PARIS SIGMA project, on the topic:
Signal-aware Graph Summarization with GNN Guarantees
This PhD lies at the intersection of graph signal processing, graph machine learning, and geometric deep learning. The goal is to develop principled methods for jointly summarizing graph structures and their associated signals while preserving the information required for signal reconstruction and downstream learning tasks.
The project will combine mathematical foundations in graph signal processing with modern graph neural networks, with a particular focus on reconstruction, learning guarantees, interpretability, and scalability to large graphs.
Supervisors:
•Jhony H. Giraldo, Télécom Paris
•Aref EINIZADE, Télécom SudParis
We are looking for candidates who:
•Hold, or are completing, an M2 or equivalent degree in engineering, data science, computer science, applied mathematics, signal processing, statistics, or a related field
•Have a strong background in signal processing and machine learning
•Have strong programming skills in Python, including PyTorch
•Have a genuine interest in graph signal processing and geometric deep learning
•Are strongly interested in understanding the mathematical foundations behind these areas
•Have good communication skills
Practical information:
•Location: Télécom Paris and Télécom SudParis, Paris-Saclay
•Research teams: MM Team at LTCI and ARMEDIA Team at SAMOVAR
•Start date: December 2026
•Duration: 3 years
To apply, please send:
•A full CV
•A motivation letter explaining your interest in the position, maximum one page
•Transcript of records
•At least one recommendation letter
Applications should be sent to:
📩 jhony.giraldo@telecom-paris.fr
📩 aref.einizade@telecom-sudparis.eu
Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the call will close once a suitable candidate is found.
Full PhD description: https://docs.google.com/viewer?url=raw.githubusercontent.com/jhonygiraldo/jhonygiraldo.github.io/master/assets/pdf/PhD_Position_SIGMA.pdf

几何深度学习与图信号处理博士职位
我们在巴黎高等电信学院和巴黎高等电信南校区（巴黎理工学院）的Hi! PARIS SIGMA项目中开设全额资助博士职位，主题：
具有GNN保证的信号感知图摘要
该博士职位位于图信号处理、图机器学习和几何深度学习的交叉点。目标是开发原则性方法，联合摘要图结构及其相关信号，同时保留信号重建和下游学习任务所需的信息。
项目将结合图信号处理的数学基础与现代图神经网络，特别关注重建、学习保证、可解释性和大规模图的可扩展性。
导师：
•Jhony H. Giraldo，巴黎高等电信学院
•Aref EINIZADE，巴黎高等电信南校区
我们寻找的候选人：
•持有或即将完成工程、数据科学、计算机科学、应用数学、信号处理、统计或相关领域的M2或同等学位
•在信号处理和机器学习方面有坚实背景
•Python编程技能强，包括PyTorch
•对图信号处理和几何深度学习有真正兴趣
•强烈兴趣理解这些领域的数学基础
•良好沟通技能
实际信息：
•地点：巴黎-Saclay的巴黎高等电信学院和南校区
•研究团队：LTCI的MM团队和SAMOVAR的ARMEDIA团队
•开始日期：2026年12月
•时长：3年
申请请发送：
•完整CV
•最多一页动机信
•成绩单
•至少一封推荐信
发送至：
📩 jhony.giraldo@telecom-paris.fr
📩 aref.einizade@telecom-sudparis.eu
滚动审查，找到合适候选人后关闭。
